note: FR-831 / TC-2113. Static inputs and expected reader results for the optional top-level protocol_correlation_occurrences member; no reader or harness executes them and no existing reader is qualified against them. A case with a non-null `edit` is executable over fixtures/protocol-node-base.json (RFC 6902 `add` on the published-form package; every eligible control of the base has an empty related array, so the base is projection P-BASE). A case with a null `edit` is an admitted-graph projection input: the carrier check reads, per eligible control occurrence, only its control NodeRef, operator, declaration occurrences, the source_map entry of the full key and that entry's regions' sources, and the length m of its emitted related array (`related_len` overrides the base's 0 by control id). Controls with in_base false (event, recommend and the two-occurrence send) are not in the base package; a full-package embodiment of those cases is the producer's own fixture. Rows follow FR-322 ascending structural NodeRef order (package, path segments by UTF-8 bytes, ordinal), then occurrence, then source_ordinal. The expected `read` is the typed read; its source_units are the sources of the regions of the admitted source_map entry of the full key (control, declaration, ordinal), here the base's one lock source. Aliases show only the Identifier lexical form: the relationship's model name (base: ix://acme/orders/relationship/Order-order-Order) is never compared with an alias. Expected refusals state the first defect in FR-831 order only.

P-BASE.description: the unmodified base: seven eligible controls (SEND RECV ATT EFF EAST WEST POLL), each with one declaration occurrence 0 and related_len 0; check Outcome/Done, commit Finalized and role Orders are ineligible

P-REL.description: P-BASE plus the in_base false controls EVT, REC and SH (two declaration occurrences); related_len states each control's m
